expressions.display_text: CASE WHEN A.Agt_Id IS NULL AND B.Agt_Id1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'I' --当天不存在历史的数据为新增 WHEN A.Agt_Id IS NOT NULL AND B.Agt_Id1 IS…
expressions.expr_text:
CASE WHEN A.Agt_Id IS NULL     AND B.Agt_Id1 IS NOT NULL THEN 'I'           --当天不存在历史的数据为新增
WHEN A.Agt_Id IS NOT NULL AND B.Agt_Id1 IS NULL THEN 'D'           --历史不存在当天的数据为删除
WHEN A.Agt_Id IS NOT NULL AND B.Agt_Id1 IS NOT NULL AND
(   COALESCE(A.Agt_Cate_Cd             ,'')   <> COALESCE(B.Agt_Cate_Cd1            ,'')
OR COALESCE(A.Agt_Type_Cd             ,'')   <> COALESCE(B.Agt_Type_Cd1            ,'')
OR COALESCE(A.Stati_Cont_Desc         ,'')   <> COALESCE(B.Stati_Cont_Desc1        ,'')
OR COALESCE(A.Stati_Qty_Info          ,'')   <> COALESCE(B.Stati_Qty_Info1         ,'')
OR COALESCE(A.Stati_Num_Info          ,'')   <> COALESCE(B.Stati_Num_Info1         ,'')
OR COALESCE(A.Stati_Subdv_Cd          ,'')   <> COALESCE(B.Stati_Subdv_Cd1         ,'')
) THEN 'U'                                                        --当天和历史均存在,除主键外如有字段变更为变更
ELSE 'S' END AS DATA_TYPE
